d: Egis is a leading global architectural, consulting, construction engineering, operations and mobility services firm. We create and operate intelligent infrastructure and buildings that both respond to the climate emergency and contribute to balanced, sustainable and resilient development.

Our 23,500 employees operate across over 70 countries, deploying their expertise to develop and deliver cutting-edge innovations and solutions for clients. Through the wide range of our activities, we are central to the collective organisation of society and the living environment of citizens all over the world.
q: Strong client-facing communication skills and ability to assist investor relations.
Strong analytical, business-case development and presentation skills
Strong partnership development and stakeholder management skills
Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint required.
r: li
Coordinates and supervises the construction process from the conceptual development stage through final construction, making sure that the project is completed on time.
li
Evaluates and helps determine appropriate construction delivery systems and the most cost-effective plan and schedule for completing the project
li
Oversees the performance of all trade contractors and is responsible for ensuring that all work is completed on schedule.
li

Direct the work for Sr. Architectural, Electrical, Structural & Mechanical and other sub-ordinates, in arranging review of shop drawings, method statements, material and site inspections, as-built drawings, O & M Manuals, warranties, etc.,
li
Monitoring suitability and availability of drawings and other data to ensure the contractor has the right information for the work in hand.
li
Monitoring the quality and timeliness of inspections carried out by the consultant.
li
Monitoring contractors for compliance with their contractual responsibilities.
li
Monitoring progress of the works for compliance with schedule.
li
Ensuring that appropriate planning tools are implemented by the contractor, including accurate look ahead schedules.
li
Ensuring that materials for the works are submitted for approval in time, delivered on time and suitably stored on site prior to incorporation in the works.
li
Ensuring that client furnished materials are requested in sufficient time to permit purchase and deliver to site without delay to the schedule.
li
Ensuring that each contractor complies with the current coordinated method statement for coordinating with other contractors.
li
Monitoring contractor’s compliance with security requirements.
li
Immediate reporting of any infraction or occurrence that constitutes a serious infraction or emergency.
li
Ensuring issues related to projects are properly entered into the issue logs and are then addressed and resolved in an appropriate fashion.
li
Recommending approvals / disapproval of variation orders/claims.
li
Establishing and maintaining the procedures for meetings, meeting documentation, follow up and tracking of issues and participate actively in resolving outstanding issues.
li
Receiving all project related correspondence and communication and providing direction and action to his team including consultants and contractors.
li
Identifying and minimizing the risks of potential claims
li
Reviewing, analyzing and preparing recommended actions for disputes and claims
li
Preparing documentation for all occurrences in the field on a daily basis.
li
Coordinating claim mitigation, contract interpretation and cost analysis for submitted claims and maintaining all relevant documentation.
li
Reviewing contractor submitted resumes and plans for contract compliance.

Coordinating and managing pre-bid activities including meetings, addenda, answers to bidder questions and bid evaluation.
